summary: Three listed churches (Queen of Heaven, Fourteen Holy Helpers, St. John Vianney) with an unchanged Mass schedule box in all three bulletins; the bulletin is image-only so it was read from rendered pages. First Saturday 8 AM Mass at Queen of Heaven is first-Saturday only (history read it as weekly). Left out: St. Gabriel's (not on the church list) and St. John XXIII (another parish). Open: the Oct 19 School Mass in the school open house, and whether the Adoration Chapel at 839 Mill Rd (hours only in the Sept 27 bulletin) belongs to Queen of Heaven.

sources.said: Reminder about new times for Exhibition of the Eucharist. The Eucharist is exposed: Weekdays: Monday through Thursday: 6am-11pm
Queen of Heaven Eucharistic Adoration Chapel, 839 Mill Rd., West Seneca, NY 14224

slots.rationale: R29/R32: the newest bulletin (p8) prints only the chapel's name and address, 839 Mill Rd, with no hours; the hours (Mon-Thu 6am-11pm, Friday 6am through Sunday 11pm, open 24 hours with a code) are in the Sept 27 bulletin (p5). The church list puts Queen of Heaven Church at 4220 Seneca Street, but the bulletin also calls 839 Mill St the church's front lawn (Legion of Mary rally) and the school is at 839 Mill Road, so it is unclear whether the chapel is on the church grounds. I lean leave out (POLICY: unclear location or another address, R22/R23).
